items.title: How to Start Building on ICP
items.summary_short: What is ICP? The Internet Computer Protocol (ICP) is a public blockchain network that enables the development of Web3 applications and services 100% on-chain. Even internetcomputer.org is hosted and served by the ICP blockchain!
